title: VP UCaaS, UK & Ireland
description:
**Join Telavox as our VP of UCaaS for the UK & Ireland**
--------------------------------------------------------


We help Operators and Service Providers across Europe and the Middle East, like E& and Free Pro, grow their B2B business with our state-of-the-art UCaaS platform. Operators integrate their fixed and mobile voice services with our platform. This lets them offer businesses of all sizes a complete suite: fixed and mobile telephony, a cloud phone system, AI, integrations, analytics, collaboration and omnichannel features. Telavox Group is growing and profitable, with +1.6bsek in revenue and +400 Telavoxers in nine countries. Our ambition is clear: building a global software company serving Operators.

#### **About the job**


Our customers are MNOs and Cloud PBX & VoIP Carriers that distribute our UCaaS service as part of their own portfolio. The UK and Ireland is one of the most dynamic telecom markets in Europe, and we already have a foothold in the UK through existing Operator partnerships. We are now looking for a seasoned, results-driven VP UCaaS to open doors at the highest level, win new business and take our UK & Ireland presence to the next level.


This is a senior, pure hunter role. Your mission is to identify, prospect and close new Operator and Service Provider partnerships across the UK and Ireland, driving revenue growth for Telavox's mobile UCaaS offering. Our UK Key Account Manager looks after existing customers, so you can focus fully on new business. You report to the Head of Business Unit Telavox Platform, and initially the role has no direct reports.

**Main responsibilities:**

* Own new business end to end, from prospecting and pipeline building to negotiating and closing deals with Operators and Service Providers in the UK and Ireland
* Build and maintain a strong, qualified pipeline, build business cases, and forecast revenue against ambitious targets
* Develop and execute the UK & Ireland go-to-market plan with Marketing, Product and leadership, and drive joint go-to-market initiatives with new Operator partners to help them win more end customers
* Engage senior stakeholders across the Operator organisation and partner with Product, Engineering and Customer Service Delivery at Telavox to shape a winning offering and ensure successful delivery
* Work closely with our UK Key Account Manager to secure smooth handovers
* Represent Telavox at industry events and in the UK & Ireland operator and channel ecosystem


This role is remote/hybrid, based in the UK or Ireland. We offer a competitive senior package with base salary and attractive variable pay, and a real stake in the success you help build.

#### **About you**


You have done this before, with clear and proven success. You bring extensive experience selling telecom software to Operators and Service Providers, a track record of winning new logos and closing complex, high-value B2B deals, and a strong senior network across UK and Irish Operators. As a person you are resilient, target-driven, and thrive on hunting new business, and you enjoy building something from an early stage.

**Key capabilities:**

* Market insight and network: Comprehensive understanding of the UK and Irish telecom landscape, regulation and key players, with a strong C-level operator and channel network.
* Telecom expertise: In-depth knowledge of VoIP, SIP trunking, UCaaS and MNO/Service Provider business models.
* Sales and partnerships: Proven in solution selling, building pipelines, negotiating complex contracts, and securing high-value partnerships.
* Builder mindset: Thrives with high ownership in a growing market and is motivated by the opportunity to build the business, and potentially a team, as it grows.
* Degree in Business, Telecommunications or similar; MBA is a plus. Fluent in English.

#### **Join us at Telavox**


Since Telavox's journey started in 2002, we have strengthened our position as the leading forward-thinking communication platform for businesses. As a digital mobile operator, we develop and own our all-in-one communication platform, which integrates telephony, PBX, messaging, meetings, and contact centers, giving businesses a smarter way to connect.  

  

We offer flexible work options and adaptable hours, giving you the freedom to balance life and career while staying connected to our vibrant Telavox culture.


Read more about our new HQ in Malmö !

### **How to apply!**


At Telavox, we don’t focus on fitting in. We focus on making room for everyone, regardless of background, experience, or who you are.


We’re always looking for great talent, and we review applications on an ongoing basis. If you’re excited about joining an innovative, AI-driven telecom company, we’d love to hear from you! Apply with your CV and cover letter in English.


Please note that, in accordance with GDPR, we only accept applications through our recruitment system, not by email.

 **Learn more about what we do! ️**

title: Senior DevOps Engineer
description:

Justera Group AB is a leading Swedish IT consulting firm with great experience specializing in building high-performing technology teams and delivering end-to-end IT solutions. Led by dynamic female executives, Justera Group focuses on helping businesses harness the power of digital technologies to continuously evolve in today’s rapidly changing economy. We are looking for an experienced DevOps Engineer to take ownership of and develop CI/CD infrastructure across embedded and cloud software environments. The primary focus is on an on-premises toolchain for embedded software development, built around Jenkins, Docker, and Gerrit, with integrated static analysis.


The role also involves managing CI/CD pipelines for web services using Azure DevOps, with deployments to AWS and Azure. This is a technically diverse assignment that requires someone who can work independently, translate high-level objectives into actionable plans, and take ownership of priorities and improvements.

**Location:** Jonsered (SE)

* Operate, maintain, and develop the on-premises CI/CD environment using Jenkins, Docker, and Gerrit.
* Develop and maintain Jenkins pipelines and automation using Groovy and Python.
* Integrate and optimise static analysis tools such as CodeChecker and cppcheck into build and code review workflows.
* Develop and maintain Azure DevOps pipelines for web services deployed to AWS and Azure.
* Improve the stability, performance, security, and scalability of build and deployment infrastructure.
* Plan and prioritise technical improvements based on high-level objectives.
* Collaborate with development teams to improve workflows and delivery processes.
* Document infrastructure, configurations, and processes.
* Support developers in using CI/CD tools and resolving related issues.

**Requirements:**

* More than 5 years of hands-on experience in DevOps and CI/CD.
* Expert-level knowledge of Jenkins, including declarative and scripted Groovy pipelines and shared libraries.
* Strong experience with Docker and containerised build environments.
* Experience with Gerrit or a comparable Git-based code review workflow integrated with CI.
* Proficiency in Python for automation and tooling.
* Experience with Azure DevOps Pipelines, particularly YAML-based pipelines.
* Experience deploying applications and services to AWS and Azure.
* Experience integrating static analysis tools such as CodeChecker, cppcheck, or similar.
* Strong Linux system administration skills.
* Ability to work independently, take ownership, and effectively plan and prioritise tasks.
* Fluent spoken and written English.

**What We Offer:**

* A dynamic and innovative workplace driving advancements in cutting-edge robotic technologies
* The opportunity to collaborate with talented cross-functional teams on meaningful and impactful projects
* Competitive compensation and comprehensive benefits package
* A supportive culture that fosters continuous learning, growth, and professional development
* Flexible hybrid working model for an optimal work-life balance
* 25 days of annual leave to recharge and relax
* An annual wellness allowance of 3,500 SEK to support your health and wellbeing

title: Engineering Lead, Payments
description:
**TL;DR:** We’re looking for an experienced Engineering Lead to build and scale Lovable’s payments infrastructure. You’ve built payment systems at scale before. You’ll shape the architecture, develop critical payment capabilities, and guide the team through the technical challenges of global growth.

**Why Lovable?**


Lovable is the software creation platform that gives people the power to act on the problems closest to them. For decades, turning an idea into software required so much capital, technical fluency, and time that many ideas never came to life. Lovable is the counterargument: a platform for all people with ideas, ambition, and problems worth solving. From solopreneurs to small business owners to teams at companies like Adidas and Zendesk, people have built over 60 million projects on Lovable since its launch in November 2024. And we’re just getting started.


We’re building a generational company from Stockholm, with growing teams in London, Boston, New York, and San Francisco. Our team is small, talent-dense, and moving quickly, with a culture rooted in extreme ownership, high velocity, and low-ego collaboration. We look for people who care deeply, ship fast, and are eager to make a dent in the world.


Lovable is one of TIME’s 100 Most Influential Companies and has been recognized on the Forbes AI 50 and CNBC Disruptor 50, reflecting our momentum as one of Europe’s fastest-growing AI companies and one of the most ambitious places to build in this next era of software.

**What we’re looking for**

* A proven track record of personally building and scaling production payments infrastructure, from architecture through implementation and ongoing operations.
* Deep experience with payment processing, recurring billing, provider integrations, and reconciliation.
* Excellent judgment in distributed systems, including financial correctness, idempotency, consistency, and failure recovery.
* Experience leading engineers through complex architectural decisions, migrations, and production incidents.
* An engineering leader with the technical depth and judgment to simplify complex systems and raise the quality of the team’s decisions.

**What you’ll do**

* **Build critical systems.** Design and implement payment flows, recurring billing, and provider integrations, taking projects from initial design through production.
* **Set the technical direction.** Guide architectural decisions, create and review code, and work closely with the team on the most challenging problems.
* **Own reliability.** Investigate production issues, improve observability, and strengthen how our systems handle failures, retries, and scale.
* **Lead engineering delivery.** Turn complex problems into clear plans, coach engineers, and take responsibility for shipping and operating high-quality systems.
* **Connect engineering to business outcomes.** Work with Payments, Product, Finance, and Operations to improve payment success, reduce losses, and support global growth.

**Our tech stack**
------------------


We're building with tools that both humans and AI love. Lovable software engineers are capable of working across the whole stack. Examples of tech in our stack include:

* **Frontend**: React and Typescript.

* **Data:** Clickhouse, Firestore, Spanner, BigQuery.

And always on the lookout for what's next!

**About your application**


Please submit your application in English. It’s our company language, so you’ll be speaking lots of it if you join.


Tell us about payments infrastructure you’ve built: your technical ownership, the scale, the hardest trade-offs, and how it performed in production.


We treat all candidates equally. If you’re interested, please apply through our careers portal.

title: Platform Engineer - Security & Compliance
description:
Validio is the agentic data management platform that automates data quality, lineage, and cataloging, so enterprises can finally trust the data behind their analytics, AI, and reporting. As a Platform Engineer focused on Security & Compliance, you own how we prove that trust, and you do it like an engineer, not an administrator.


As we move up-market into banking and regulated industries, a SOC 2 report, an ISO 27001 certificate, and a credible answer to “how do you protect our data” increasingly decide whether a deal closes. This is a hands-on DevSecOps role inside our Platform Engineering team. You’ll own our compliance program end to end, but you’ll run it from a terminal. You’ll turn control requirements into Terraform, CI checks, and custom tests, so controls stay green without anyone chasing screenshots. It’s not a pure cybersecurity or policy role. You’ll write code and work on the platform alongside the rest of the team.

**What you’ll do**

* Own our compliance frameworks (SOC 2, ISO 27001, GDPR, HIPAA, and DORA) and run audit cycles from evidence-gathering to the audit room
* Run our Vanta instance and automate it: build custom tests in Go or Python, automate evidence collection, and wire controls into Terraform and GitHub Actions so drift is caught in a PR, not an audit
* Implement the technical measures behind our security policies across GCP, AWS, and Azure, including access management and reviews, logging, secrets, and hardening
* Own security questionnaires and our trust center, and rebuild the answer library so a bank’s 300-question questionnaire takes days, not weeks
* Run vendor security reviews and the data-protection assessments that come with them (DPIAs, LIAs, TRIAs), and keep our risk register honest
* Pitch in on platform and reliability work with the rest of the team

**What you’ll bring**

* A background in platform, DevOps, cloud, or security engineering. You’ve built and run infrastructure, not just audited it
* Experience owning or heavily supporting a SOC 2 and/or ISO 27001 program, and the ability to turn a control requirement into concrete technical tasks
* Hands-on experience with cloud infrastructure, ideally GCP (strong AWS or Azure experience also works)
* Production experience with Kubernetes, Terraform, and CI/CD, and enough Go or Python to build the automation this role needs
* Experience with a GRC automation platform such as Vanta, Drata, or Secureframe (Vanta a strong plus), and a firm preference for automating evidence over collecting it by hand
* Clear, persuasive writing: questionnaire answers an enterprise security team trusts, and documentation an auditor accepts the first time
* The drive to get things to closure, including chasing control owners across engineering, IT, HR, and legal

**Bonus points for**

* ISO 27001 Lead Implementer / Lead Auditor, CISA, Security+, CISM, or CISSP
* Supporting compliance for financial-services or other regulated customers
* Vendor-risk (TPRM) experience

**Our stack, and why**


We use Vanta for compliance automation, because evidence should come from systems, not screenshots. Our infrastructure spans Google Cloud, AWS, and Azure because our customers run on all three, and our workloads run on Kubernetes across GKE, EKS, and AKS. Everything is defined in Terraform and shipped through GitHub Actions, so controls, evidence, and enforcement live in code you can read, query, and test. We write internal tooling and custom tests in Go and Python. Where the automation isn’t there yet, you build it.

**Why Validio**


Founded in Sweden in 2019, we’re trusted by data-driven enterprises like Nordea, Canva, Truecaller, Traveloka, and Deutsche Glasfaser. We raised a $30M Series A this year and grew ARR 800% in twelve months as enterprises got serious about making their data AI-ready. We’re 35 people today and growing fast across Sweden, London, New York, and Amsterdam. This role is hybrid, and we expect you to work from our Stockholm office at least a couple of days per week. You’ll own initiatives end to end and make the call when you’re closest to the problem. We’re strict about testing and documentation, and fast about decisions.


Come as you are. We hire for what you’ll build with us, and we welcome applicants of every background.

Hos one.com har vi vores kundekontakt som højeste prioritet! Vi arbejder hårdt for altid at yde support og kundeservice i verdensklasse, for at sikre os, at selv på et marked med hård konkurrence, føler vores kunder at de får alt de behøver, og lidt til.  

Dette er en unik mulighed for at blive en del af et team hvor alle arbejder mod samme mål: at yde nordens absolut bedste support og kundeservice til vores kunder. Vi gør ingenting halvhjertet, men arbejder kontinuerligt for at overgå os selv, mens vi har det sjovt på arbejdet og udvikler os både individuelt og som et team.

Vi vil som sagt give vores kunder en oplevelse i verdensklasse når de kontakter os for support. Du kommer til at arbejde på vores kontor i Glasvasen lige ved Malmö Central.

title: Senior Patent Attorney
description:
**Join our Team**
-----------------

 **About this opportunity**  

Ericsson owns one of the most valuable patent portfolios in the ICT industry, with over 60,000 granted patents spanning cellular technology, cloud, consumer electronics and more. As part of the Patent Creation Management team within the global IPR & Licensing Organisation, you will help shape and protect inventions arising from Ericsson's antenna technology research and related global initiatives.  

This role suits someone who enjoys change, values precision and wants to grow within a globally leading technology company. Both experienced patent professionals and engineers or researchers looking to move into IP management are welcome to apply.

 **What you will do**  

* Work with R&D teams in Gothenburg and globally to identify and develop patentable telecom inventions.
* Manage your own patent docket with accuracy and precision.
* Carry out claim charting and technical analysis.
* Handle invention disclosures and contribute to portfolio strategy.
* Support in-house patent drafting and prosecution.
* Act as a bridge between patent attorneys and R&D teams on technical matters.
* Keep up to date with developments in European and international patent law, telecom standards and emerging technologies.
* Collaborate with legal, technical and business colleagues in an international, cross-functional team.
 **You will bring**  

* In-depth knowledge of telecom technology, such as antenna, wireless transport, core networks, 3GPP radio or mission critical, gained through professional experience, research or technical expertise.
* A master's degree in engineering, physics, computer science or a related field.
* Either (partial) qualification as a European Patent Attorney, or strong hands-on technical experience with a genuine interest in patents and a motivation to develop IPR expertise.
* A solid understanding of telecommunication technologies.
* Strong coordination and communication skills, a keen eye for detail and the ability to manage multiple priorities accurately.
* Substantial on-site availability at the Rosenheim location.
* Experience in patent portfolio management.
* Hands-on patent drafting and prosecution experience.
* Knowledge of other telecommunication areas.
* Familiarity with AI-based drafting tools and modern IP workflows.
* Openness to continuous learning and developing towards full patent attorney responsibilities.
**Application**  

We look forward to your application with CV in English. We target 60% attendance at office.
  

Last day to apply: 11th of November 2026  

Please note that we do not accept, proceed, or respond for applications sent via e-mail.


If you have specific questions, you are welcome to contact Christian Vejgaard, Director Patent Unit GRO at christian.vejgaard@ericsson.com Raheleh Rouhani, Sr. Talent Acquisition Partner at raheleh.rouhani@ericsson.com


Location: Gothenburg, Sweden

We truly believe that by collaborating with people with different experiences we drive innovation, which is essential for our future growth. We encourage people from all backgrounds to apply and realize their full potential as part of our Ericsson team. Ericsson is proud to be an Equal Opportunity Employer. learn more.

title: Lead DevOps Engineer
description:
The highest calling for AI is improving human health. At Perceptic, we're building the AI operating system that powers drug discovery - a unified intelligence layer that connects evidence, reasoning, and action across the entire drug lifecycle.


We were built by operators from Palantir who spent years deploying production AI in the world's most demanding enterprise environments. We know what it takes to make ambitious technology hold up under real pressure. Now we're applying that to pharma and we're hiring engineers who've operated at the same standard.


A single drug can take more than a decade and billions of dollars to reach a patient, and the systems we build are meant to compress that timeline. They run inside some of the most security-conscious, compliance-bound enterprises in the world, where the infrastructure underneath has to be as trustworthy as the science on top of it.


We need a Lead DevOps Engineer to own that infrastructure end to end. You'll be the single, clear owner of how Perceptic deploys, operates, secures, and scales, across our own platform and across the isolated customer environments where the bar for trust is absolute. It's a large amount of responsibility, which is exactly what we're offering.

**What you'll own**

* Our GitOps deployment backbone on Argo CD, so a small team can ship continuously and safely across many clusters
* Kubernetes on AWS (EKS) across our fleet of production environments
* Infrastructure-as-code in Terraform/OpenTofu and Terragrunt, the source of truth for everything we run
* Multi-tenant, per-customer isolation: standing up a fully isolated, compliant environment for each pharma customer, with its own cluster and data plane, and deploying to it with confidence. This is the hardest and most important part of the job.
* Security and compliance posture: secrets management, access controls, infrastructure hardening, and the SOC2-and-beyond controls that customers will audit you on
* Observability: telemetry, metrics, logging, tracing, dashboards, and alerting that keep a complex distributed system legible
* Reliability, incident response, and the operational runbooks that protect customer trust
* CI/CD and release automation that keep our shipping cadence high
* Developer experience: making it fast and painless for engineers to deploy and debug

**What we're looking for**

* At least 4 years in DevOps, platform engineering, SRE, or infrastructure
* You've owned production systems rather than only contributing to them, including multi-tenant or customer-specific environments, and you understand the complexity that comes with them
* Deep fluency with Kubernetes, a major cloud (AWS preferred), GitOps, and infrastructure-as-code, plus the judgment to know when not to add another layer
* You come from somewhere that held a high bar, and you expect engineering excellence from yourself and the systems around you
* You're hands-on and have no interest in a purely architectural role. You explain complex tradeoffs simply and you don't over-engineer.
* You treat speed, security, cost, and reliability as constraints that all apply at once, and you've struck that balance before
* Bonus: you've operated under formal security or compliance regimes (SOC2, HIPAA, GxP, or similar) and know how to make controls a strength rather than a tax


This is a high-intensity, high-stakes role. We move quickly and give direct feedback, the responsibility you carry will likely outrun your title, and you'll go wherever the company needs you most, which sometimes means unglamorous work that matters more than anything else that week. The people who do well here find that kind of ownership and growth exciting, and they weren't looking for a nine-to-five.

title: Enterprise Account Executive
description:
Edge AI is about to change how industry makes decisions in real-time. Stream Analyze has built a platform that makes it possible to develop, deploy and manage AI models on large fleets of edge devices. Fast, scalable and business-critical.


The company is in a position where the technology is proven and the market is mature. Demand is increasing, business is getting bigger and now the commercial organization is being strengthened with two Enterprise Account Executives with a clear focus on new customers and collaborations.

***The role***


This is not a management role! It is a role for those who want to open new doors, build businesses from the ground up, and work with complex solution and idea sales where technology and business meet.


You are responsible for the entire sales process – from identification and qualification to negotiation and closing – primarily within Automotive and Industrial Manufacturing. The deals are strategic, often international and involve decision-makers at Cxx level.


You work closely with the product and management team and have the opportunity to influence both the offering and go-to-market, in a growing organization where your contribution is both visible and measurable.


We are looking for someone who has:

* Solid experience in Enterprise sales of complex software or technical solutions
* Ability to drive structured sales processes from first contact to signed agreement
* Experience working towards CxO level, and in international environments
* A strong personal drive and confidence in working in an organization where all processes are not pre-packaged
* Very good knowledge of Swedish and English, both spoken and written. You should be able to draft and review agreements and other legal documents in both languages without any problems.
* Opportunity to travel in your work
* Additional languages, especially German or French, are an advantage.

***Offer***


As AI moves out of the cloud to the Edge, the playing field changes. Stream Analyze is developing a platform that enables advanced analytics directly on autonomous units where decisions must be made in real time. The technology is already being used in demanding environments and the company is now entering an expansive phase.


You are offered an opportunity to work with a technologically leading platform within Edge AI in a company with strong ownership and a clear growth agenda. The role provides a large mandate, competitive compensation and a commission model that reflects the strategic value of the deals.


You are expected not only to sell but also to contribute to how the company positions, packages and develops its offering. Together with a high-performing team, you translate technical expertise into concrete business benefits.

title: Cloud Solution Engineer (Azure + .NET)
description:
We’re looking for a Senior Cloud Software Engineer to help design, build, and scale cloud-native solutions that power risktec’s platform. You’ll work across the full lifecycle—from architecture and development to deployment, monitoring, and optimization—while collaborating closely with architects, product owners, and other engineering teams.

  

This role is ideal for someone who enjoys building reliable systems, cares deeply about code quality, and understands how cloud services, security, and cost all fit together in real-world production environments.

  

⸻

  

What You’ll Do

  

Code Development

* Build efficient, maintainable cloud-native applications primarily using .NET Core
* Design and implement APIs and services following industry standards (REST, CloudEvents, OData)
* Write comprehensive unit and integration tests to ensure high code quality
  

Cloud Service Integration

* Provision and integrate cloud services (compute, storage, databases) to create cohesive solutions
* Use Infrastructure as Code (e.g. Terraform) to define and manage cloud infrastructure
  

Security Implementation

* Apply cloud security best practices including encryption, access controls, and secure configurations
* Ensure data confidentiality, integrity, and compliance across environments
  

Scalability & Performance

* Design systems that scale reliably under increased load
* Continuously optimize performance to deliver a great user experience
  

CI/CD & Automation

* Build and maintain CI/CD pipelines to automate testing, deployment, and delivery
* Support rapid, safe, and repeatable releases
  

Monitoring & Troubleshooting

* Implement monitoring and alerting to proactively detect and resolve issues
* Ensure high availability and operational reliability
  

Cost Management

* Optimize cloud resource usage with cost, performance, and scalability in mind
* Make informed decisions around instance sizing, storage, and data transfer
  

Collaboration & Documentation

* Work closely with cross-functional teams and stakeholders
* Maintain clear documentation to support knowledge sharing and long-term maintainability
* Proactively clarify requirements and drive assigned topics forward
  

Compliance & Governance

* Ensure solutions meet regulatory and governance requirements
* Follow industry standards and internal best practices
  

System Architecture (Senior Level)

* Contribute to the design of scalable, secure, and cost-efficient cloud architectures
* Review designs and implementations with a long-term, system-wide perspective
  

What We’re Looking For

* Strong experience with .NET Core and cloud-native development
* Solid understanding of cloud platforms and managed services
* Experience with IaC, CI/CD, and production operations
* A security- and quality-first mindset
* Comfortable collaborating across teams and influencing technical decisions
* Ability to think in systems, not just features

title: Interested in an Internship at Xenit?
description:
W A N T T O W O R K A T X E N I T ?
  
Apply for an LIA/internship and you'll have the opportunity to work with some of Sweden's leading specialists in Cloud and Modern Work ️
  
  

We're currently looking for interns who will be with us for around 3 months as we feel this is enough time to get you up to speed and working well within the team.
  
  

As an intern, you will work within our Core IT team, focusing on troubleshooting complex issues, and collaborating with specialized teams for problem resolution and service improvements. You will learn more about cloud solutions, networking, security/identity and the Microsoft eco-system as a whole.
  
You will get the chance to work with products from our partners; such as Citrix, Palo Alto and of course, Microsoft.
  
  

If you are successful in your application and receive a placement at Xenit, we will assign you a mentor, who will act as your main point of contact throughout your time with us. We hope that this will open a clear communication channel for if you have any questions or concerns throughout your time here.
  
  

You will work at our office at Kungstorget 7, with the ability to participate in meetings, workshops and any other company activities.
  
If you impress during your internship, you may even receive a permanent job offer
  
  

H O W W E C H O O S E ‍️
  
In order to stand out from the rest, make sure that you include as much detail in your application as possible. Be creative. Show us why you deserve a place more than another applicant.
  
  

**A successful application may include:**  

* Proof of a great interest in IT (particularly within cloud solutions or modern work)
* High school/college grades
* Any certifications gained or relevant courses taken
* Fluency in English and Swedish (verbal and written)


W H A T W E N E E D
  
Even if we would like to, we cannot accept all LIA applications. We receive many applications each year and try to pick out those which are the best match for Xenit, skill and attitude wise.
  
  

**We require the following from you:**  

* CV and Cover letter
* Time period for your LIA/practice (preferably around 3 months)
* What you need your LIA/internship to contain (if there are requirements in connection with your education)
* Grades and certifications
* Any specific area of interest to you


D E T A I L S ‍️
  
There is the possibility of LIA/internship both during the spring semester and autumn semester - scope and access according to regulations in your education program. The internship will take place during normal office hours, approximately 08.00-17.00.
  
  

If you have questions about the advertisement, please contact our Head of Talent, Abigail Chapman
